title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
ii.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
iii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iv.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
seed_phrase: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still op
